params.1273: Fletch a shortbow so you can use it to fire arrows.
params.1274: Get a <col=FFFFFF>log</col> by cutting down a tree
params.1275: Click a <col=FFFFFF>log</col> in your inventory, choose <col=FFFFFF>knife</col>, and then <col=FFFFFF>shortbow</col>. If you need more logs, you can chop down some trees.
params.1276: Pick some <col=FFFFFF>flax</col> to string the bow with.
params.1277: Click on a <col=FFFFFF>spinning wheel</col> while you have the flax and choose <col=FFFFFF>bow string</col>.
params.1278: Use the <col=FFFFFF>bow string</col> with the <col=FFFFFF>shortbow (u)</col> to create a shortbow.
